notes.title: Patch Note 1.203 & brand new casual Mini-Game!

notes.title: Evomon Final Major Update 1.2 - Pre-historic
notes.content:
Welcome  to the Final Major Update of Evomon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ae3f95d524b21fc5de30a28371b98e3442e23c81.gif

In this Update we are going to explore the ancient secrets of Evotopia ! 

A new Expedition full of secrets is available 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/6e1e75fbd5618407c2c0434ad7bdd3528c251965.gif

27 New Evomons 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/cd2fbc1b0363d5704a0ede53f763090ad29f0a87.gif

A New Misterious Fusion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/0018128abeffeaadbc8374b238262ec43d964091.gif

New Items 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ee2db6ea32d4432b6c8408361be0820b9846274f.png

New Furnitures to be found on the EvoStore gacha machine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/61f89ea3355011f57a43f20c1ba6a36f53f557fa.png

Evomini Major sprite overhaul for the expedition mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/39ee9f627abe6d58079fdb60cdf2f10d32e9e406.gif

New Mini-Game Medals Challenges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7764c76c67b2a6c695a8f5050ca5534e345f6fc8.gif

In this update we've also added several improvements to the game based on your suggestions
- Several Graphics Polishments
   *New Game Studio Splash Art 
   *New Borders to Encapsulate the game
   *New Ui for money in-game
   *New Icons for showing frozen and evomon DNA
   *Arena Graphics polishment
   *Updated night backgrounds
   *Brand New Evolution Scene
   *You can now pet evomons (hearts animations) 

- Several Bug Fixes
  *Fixed a bug where the game would crash during the Christmas Event
  *Fixed a bug where the expedition boss would stop moving 

- General Balancement
  *We now need hammers to unlock new mini-games we get hammers after playing mini-games
  *less clicks to hatch evomons

After many improvements and content added, its time for us to move forward.
We are planning a sequel for the Evomon Series !
Join us on the official discord to know more! : https://discord.gg/h9ankrZa

notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.content:
Welcome to update 1.1 of Evomon 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/4e5143d254fb1d05ad700964aaee595cf6e21108.png

Back when i was a kid i remember going to my hometown square and trading my cards and toys with my friends
it was such a special feeling of interaction ✨ 

i'm trying to convey and bring back these feelings within Evomon

 📈 EvoTrade 📉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7a35fd4196aa9c38c5dfa62b39d7cbe55512ad35.png

1) Evotrade will be the first online feature on the Evomon game !
on the Evotrade you will pay some coins to be able to trade any evomon you currently own wich your friends of Steam or any person that owns the game 
--------------------------
📨  There's also a neat chatbox where you will be able to talk with your friends inside the game! 
--------------------------

✨ Ara Evomons
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/4b71d4aab3c0394baf37fe704ae49a430a891c1f.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/a51524409bebe8f8191745fb27ec87df5984408c.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/bf7044982082f78bab6b535e4f3d5eb9932310c8.gif

2) ✨Ara Evomons  ✨ 
This update will be coming together with the Ara Evomons update

✨ Ara Evomons are very rare Evomons that you can find (if you're lucky enough inside evoeggs and monster reviving)

and you will be able to trade your Aras with your friends and complete your evopedia!

Quests
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/fae200b9d467f07aa491ef4dbf2772c376c0d1dc.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/ea524e8e3cfaf9609c7b8f53bd1b590b943e37df.png

3) 2 New quests
There will be 2 new quests inside the game , which you'll be able to complete and get rewarded new evomons

New Evomons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/8489802cd3afc00bcbe76fc56f7d2c9667c43667.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/5a60b204e7cc64d86c3ef3a9fb5349ce51903ca9.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/c9a21f2813b6c0234e18680d4dfbdc602b75b4ce.gif

4) 30 New Evomons
We are adding 15 New Evomons and their Ara version in the game to collect and find making the Evopedia even larger.

General Polishment

5) General gamefeel improvement / bug fixes
We will be polishing the game art and some of the mechanics to make the game loop much more enjoyable
we will be also fixing bugs reported by the players

New Artwork!

6) New Cover for the game
Last but not least, we got an amazing experienced monartist that will remake our Game imagery (new steam banners ! ✨)

We hope everyone enjoy the update and stay tuned on the discord community for new upcoming news
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/KhTz4wbhv7

notes.title: Patch v1.019
notes.content:
After listening to the feedback of the community we were working on some updates on the expedition boss battle :

* Made the enemy attack the collision box of fire balls  much smaller so its now easier to escape, 
* And also lowered the life of the trees and blocks to 1 so they're easily out of the way while playing
* Boss now will shoot 1 projectile on the first expedition 2 on the second expedition 3 on the third expedition
* general game feel improvements

PS: If you haven't yet, be sure to grab all the christmas items the event, will end after the last day of the year!

notes.title: EXPEDITIONEER UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/63994090fc16660183a9fd61cbfca493e6676108.png

EXPEDITIONEER UPDATE
Expedition Mode Update

We gladly present you the first update for evomon!


Updates

Added: Added evomons graphics in the expedition, we took the default tatamon graphics and now all evomons will appear in the expedition
Added: Added evomons graphics in expedition battle
Added: Freeplay mode in battle
Added: New item in Evoshop the XPNATOR
Added: New achievement in the gacha machine


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/7d487710f8f947ce4a6fce9edded1eb0a5e25eb5.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/037ea138cfbf479e3d9fbccca806b047d7e6f6c8.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42498763/a8267712ab53bcd76695f7851fd6a6db2ef02637.png

Improvements

 Improvement: expedition mode now gives experience to your evomon 
 Improvement : the more expeditions you unlock, the higher will be your expedition energy
 Improvement : Balance in the Arena battles
 Improvement : General improvements as requested by the players


Bugfixes

 Bugfix : bug fixed that the gacha doll was being distributed incorrectly
 Bugfix : bug fixed when editing mode with evopedia open
 Bugfix : text and translation


Known issue: 
Unfortunately, due to a problem with our game engine, during the update we had a problem with saved indexes in room savegames
so if you had items in your room they will probably be reset.
PS: as a bonus we are giving everyone a tatamon plushie for each room.
